A_D alone therefore puts every possible pole on the critical line; explicit pole-order bounds also involve the entire rank-six factor.
input: neither for character identities, Hecke entireness and pole support; Alpoge A_D for critical-line location. No Calegari local hypothesis and no Masullo input needed.
status: proved here using classical all-prime Artin induction, Hecke analyticity and Brauer meromorphicity with exact locators. Pole absence and general zero location are not asserted.

statement: With the two four-dimensional S5 factors holomorphic at a point, all43 distinct induced-linear-character zero-order tests are equivalent to12 explicit inequalities. A rank-five pole of order v forces relative Dedekind order q>=4v and total order r>=5v, precise common zeros, and a zero of order>=v in the other rank-five factor. If the corresponding rank-four factor is nonzero, q>=6v and r>=8v. All bounds are sharp for this exact cone, with four verified formal witnesses.
input: neither for the cone and order bounds, plus pointwise rank-four holomorphy; Calegari Theorem1.1 supplies that premise in the stated local S5 family. Alpoge A_D confines possible poles to the line. Masullo M_H conditional plus MT-S505 excludes real poles in that family.

statement: In the Calegari S5 family, let B be the single quadratic Hecke factor over the degree-six F20 field, C the rational quadratic factor, and A the specified cuspidal GL5 comparison. Assuming only B has no off-centre real zeros in(0,1), their central orders satisfy beta>=b+n. Equality, equivalently beta<=b+n, is equivalent to a finite exceptional set and exact all-place transfer of both rank-five factors. Thus the remaining comparison gate is the positive central excess beta-b-n. The same real-zero input forces the positive exceptional Euler quotient to be zero-free on Re(s)>1/2 and excludes every real Artin pole. Full GRH for B transfers to the known GL5 numerator and C even before exact transfer. The remaining central excess equals n_eta-ord(zeta_F); if positive, the exceptional-prime harmonic sum has exact singularity(k/4)log(1/epsilon)+O(1).
input: One additional conditional real-zero assertion R_B for a single quadratic Hecke function suffices for the central comparison, exceptional-prime summability and real-axis Artin holomorphy; universal Masullo M_H is sufficient but stronger. Full GRH for B is additionally used for GRH of the specified GL5 numerator and C. No Alpoge input is needed for these deductions. Classical Calegari local hypotheses and comparison construction remain.
status: proved here with complete author/root readings of the expanded proof. Exact transfer remains equivalent to beta-b-n=0; real-axis holomorphy and GRH_numerator under GRH_B do not require this equality. If excess k>0, the exact exceptional-prime Abelian logarithm is proved, with no unweighted prime-count asymptotic. General Artin holomorphy and universal Hecke GRH remain unproved.
